Verbatim extract of the v8 surface of `tizen_policy` from upstream tizen-extension.xml lines 47-649 (commit c03f3a6bf32ec7605fec0521e6dad90e358ec619). Version attribute bumped from 13 → 8 so wayland-scanner only emits requests/events available at v8. All requests are kept (even the ones we never call) so opcode numbering matches what the compositor expects. Three referenced interfaces (tizen_visibility, tizen_position, tizen_subsurface_watcher) are declared as opaque stubs.

interface.name: tizen_policy
interface.description:
The tizen_policy provides tizen-specific requests and events for window management at Tizen Platform.
[TODO] Explain the window layer at the display server. Need to explain the window layer to understand the requests and the events at tizen_policy interface.

request.name: get_visibility
request.description: Create a visibility interface for the given surface.

request.name: get_position
request.description: Create a position interface for the given surface. [TODO]: need to explain the relationship with zxdg_positioner_v6

request.name: activate
request.description: Activate the given surface. A client requests this when a client wants to raise at the top of the windows stack in the window's layer at the display server and also wants to get a keyboard focus from the display server. However the display server does not always set the focus on the reqested surface. It depends on the focus policy of the display server. A client just demands a keyboard focus via this request.

request.name: activate_below_by_res_id

description.summary: activate the res_id and position below res_id

request.description: Activate the surface associated with the given res_id and position it below the surface associated with the below_res_id. A client uses this reuquest when it want to change the order of the window stack with the gloal resource ids which are the surfaces belonging to different processes. However, this requestit does not work when the surface associated with the below_res_id is a parent of the surface assicated with the res_id.

request.name: raise
request.description: This request raises the given surface to the top of the window stack in a window layer. A client can decide the window layer with the window_type for the given surface through the set_type request of tizen_policy interface. The surface positions at the top in the window layer.

request.name: lower
request.description: This request lowers the given surface to the bottom of the window stack in a window layer. The surface positions at the bottom in the window layer.

request.name: lower_by_res_id
request.description: This request lowers the surface associated with the given res_id to the bottom of the window stack in a window layer. The surface positions at the bottom in the window layer.

request.name: set_focus_skip

description.summary: be unable to be the focused surface

request.description: This request makes the given surface unable to be the focused surface. The display server must not give the focus to the surface.

request.name: unset_focus_skip

description.summary: enable to be the focused surface

request.description: This request makes the given surface enable to be the focused surface.

request.name: set_role

description.summary: set the role of the surface

request.description: Give the role to the given surface. A client set the tizen-specific role of the surface except for the role of xdg_surface interface, xdg_top_level, xdg_popup and so on.

enum.name: win_type
enum.description:
A client can set the window type through the set_type request with win_type values. The value gives the surface the window_state, the z-order at the window stack in the window layer and other types in the display server.
The following values are window types with z-order values in descending order. Those are notification, dnd, dock, splash, fullscreen, toplevel or maximized and desktop. The menu, dnd, notification, utility, dialog, dock, splash and desktop are the window type which is defined in netwm spefification. https://specifications.freedesktop.org/wm-spec/wm-spec-1.4.html#idm46148902270160

request.name: set_type

description.summary: set the type of the surface

request.description: Set the type of the given surface. The display server use the window type for the policy of the window management which are focus management, visibility management, stack management and so on.

request.name: set_conformant
request.description: Set the conformant surface. The conformant surface can get the event through which the display server notifies the area covered by the compormant_part that is the surface in another client.

request.name: unset_conformant
request.description: Unset the conformant surface.

request.name: get_conformant
request.description: Ask if the given surface is the conformant surface or not. The display server sents the result via the confirmant event.

event.name: conformant
event.description: Notify the client when a client sends the get_conformant request.

arg.name: is_conformant
arg.summary: if the surface is conformant or not, 0 or 1

enum.name: conformant_part
enum.description: This value indicates the surface name at Tizen Platform.

event.name: conformant_area
event.description: Notify a client when the conformant area is caclulated by the another surface as the conformnat_part. This event does NOT guarantee the perfect composition of the conformant surface and the surface of the conformant part.

arg.name: conformant_part
arg.summary: the name of the conformant part

arg.name: x
arg.summary: x position of the hiding area by conformant part

arg.name: y
arg.summary: y position of the hiding area by conformant part

arg.name: w
arg.summary: width of the hiding area by conformant part

arg.name: h
arg.summary: height of the hiding area by conformant part

enum.name: error_state
enum.description: This describes the state of error.

enum.name: level
enum.description: This is the level of the notification type. This level stands for the z-order in the notification layer at the display server. The none, 1, 2, 3, default, medium, high and top is z-order in ascending order. The lower number value means the lower z-order.

request.name: set_notification_level

description.summary: set the level in the notification

request.description: This request sets the level in the notification layer. The display server decides the z-order with the given level in the notification layer.

event.name: notification_done
event.description: Notify a client when the surface is located in the z-order which has been reuqested via the set_notification_level request.

request.name: set_transient_for

description.summary: set the transient parent for parent_id

request.description: This request sets the transient parent for the surface associated with the parent_id. The surface associated with the given child_id becomes a transient children for the surface associated with the parent_id.

arg.name: child_id
arg.summary: the global resource id for the child surface

arg.name: parent_id
arg.summary: the globacl resource is for the parent surface

request.name: unset_transient_for
request.description: This reuqest unsets the transient parent on the surface associated with the child_id.

arg.name: child_id
arg.summary: the global resource id for the child surface

event.name: transient_for_done
event.description: Notify a client when the surface associated with the child_id is to set the transient parent or when it is to unset the transient parent.

arg.name: child_id
arg.summary: the global resource id for the child surface

enum.name: mode
enum.description: This value means how the screen is to operate.

request.name: set_window_screen_mode

description.summary: set the screen mode to the surface

request.description: A client sets the screen mode which it wants the screen to be as long as the given surface is shown on the screen.

event.name: window_screen_mode_done
event.description: Notify a client when the screen_mode from the client's request activates in the display server.

request.name: place_subsurface_below_parent

description.summary: place the subsurace below the parent surface

request.description: This request places the surface of the subsurface below its' parent surface.

request.name: set_subsurface_stand_alone

description.summary: make the subsurface be a stand_alone mode

request.description: This request makes the surface associated with the given subsurface not follow the policy of the window managment triggered by the parent surface. The window policy of the surface associated with the given subsurface is not affected by its parent surface.

request.name: get_subsurface

description.summary: get the subsurface of the surface with the parent_id

request.description: Get the subsurface of the given surface with the global resource parent_id.

request.name: set_opaque_state

description.summary: set the opaque state to the surface

request.description: Set the opaque state to the given surface. The display server makes this surface be opaque even if the color depth of the buffer attached to the surface is 32 depth.

request.name: iconify

description.summary: set the iconified state to the surface

request.description: Set the iconified state to the given surface. The iconfied state is the window state in which the surface is not showing on the screen.

request.name: uniconify

description.summary: set the uniconified state to the surface

request.description: Set the uniconified state to the given surface. The uniconfied state is the window state in which the iconified surface is showing on the screen.

event.name: iconify_state_changed

description.summary: change event of the iconfied state

event.description: Notify a client when the iconfied state of the surface is changed. The iconfied state is not only changed when the client requets the iconify and uniconify but also changed when the iconfied state is decided by the display server.

arg.name: iconified
arg.summary: the iconfied or uniconified state, 1 or 0

arg.name: force
arg.summary: the iconfied is forced or not, 1 or 0

request.name: add_aux_hint

description.summary: add the information of the auxiliary hint to the surface

request.description: Add the information of the auxiliary hint to the given surface. The name and the value are changed when the display server already has the same id with which the client sends this request.

arg.name: id
arg.summary: the id of the auxiliary hint

arg.name: name
arg.summary: the name of the auxiliary hint

arg.name: value
arg.summary: the vaule of the auxiliary hint

request.name: change_aux_hint

description.summary: change the value of the auxiliary hint to the surface

request.description: Change the value of the auxiliary hint id which the surface has.

arg.name: id
arg.summary: the id of the auxiliary hint

arg.name: value
arg.summary: the vaule of the auxiliary hint

request.name: del_aux_hint

description.summary: delete the information of the auxiliry hint

request.description: Delete the information of the auxiliary hint associated the hint id which the given surface has.

arg.name: id
arg.summary: the id of the auxiliary hint

request.name: get_supported_aux_hints
request.description: Get the ids of the aux hints which the given surface supports. The display server send the supported_aux_hints events as the reply of this requrest.

event.name: supported_aux_hints

description.summary: reply event for the get_supported_aux_hints request

event.description: Notify a client when the display server get the get_supported_aux_hints request. The display server send the id array of the suxiliary hints which the surface supports.

arg.name: hints
arg.summary: the id array of the auxiliary hints

event.name: allowed_aux_hint

description.summary: event of the allowed auxiliary hint

event.description: Notify a client when the auxiliary hint which the given surface has is added and changed.

arg.name: id
arg.summary: the id of the auxiliary hint

event.name: aux_message
event.description: Notify a client when the display server sends the auxiliary message. The display server can use this event when it notifies an additional information to the client.

request.name: set_background_state
request.description: Set the all surfaces associated with the given pid to be the background state. The surfaces set to be the hide state and cannot show on a screen even if the client send the show request and the activate request.

request.name: unset_background_state
request.description: Set the all surfaces associated with the given pid not to be the background state. The sufaces can allow to be showed and to be activated by the client's request.

request.name: set_floating_mode
request.description: Set the floating mode to the given surface. The surface which sets to be floating mode can be a partial window and can position over other top-level windows.

request.name: unset_floating_mode
request.description: Unset the floating mode to the given surface. The geometry of the surface does not change and the z-order of it can be the same as the top-level windows.

enum.name: stack_mode

description.summary: mode for the relative stack order

enum.description: The set_stack_mode request uses this mode values.

request.name: set_stack_mode
request.description: Set the stack mode to the given surface. The surface can changes the z-order in the same layer by the stack mode.

request.name: activate_above_by_res_id

description.summary: activate and position over the above resource id

request.description: Activate the surface associated with the given res_id which is the global resource id and set to position over the surface assoicated with the above_res_id.

request.name: get_subsurface_watcher
request.description: Get the subsurface watcher associated with the given surface. A client can get the information about the subsurface associated with the surface.

request.name: set_parent
request.description: Set the parent/client relationship. The child surface position over the parent surface.

event.name: conformant_region

description.summary: notify of geometry values of conformant region(area)

event.description: The server can notify of conformant region(area) using this event. If client is received this event, client should ack for it using tizen_policy@ack_conformant_region request.

arg.name: conformant_part
arg.summary: the name of the conformant part

arg.name: x
arg.summary: x position of the hiding area by conformant part

arg.name: y
arg.summary: y position of the hiding area by conformant part

arg.name: w
arg.summary: width of the hiding area by conformant part

arg.name: h
arg.summary: height of the hiding area by conformant part

request.name: ack_conformant_region
request.description: A client can refresh its surface for applying new conformant region which is from tizen_policy@conformant_region event. The client has to ack after complete of its updates by this request.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy this tizen_policy object.

request.name: has_video
request.description: A cleint sends the information that it has the tizen_video_object to the display server.

request.name: set_appid
request.description: Set the application id associated with the given pid.

request.name: show
request.description: Notify showing the given surface. This request means that a client is going to attach the buffer to the given surface. There is nothing to do at the display server when a client sends this request.

request.name: hide
request.description: Notify hiding the given surface. This request means that a client is going to attach the null buffer to the given surface. There is nothing to do at the display server when a client sends this request.
